$description: Hand-authored OpenType feature and variation settings per font stack. DTCG 2025.10 has no first-class `fontFeatureSettings` or `fontVariationSettings` type, so these are emitted with `$type: string` — the CSS transform passes them through verbatim.

fontFeatureSettings.$description: OpenType feature settings per stack — enables ligatures, tabular nums, character variants.

mono.$description: JetBrains Mono ligatures + contextual alts + slashed zero.

fontVariationSettings.$description: Variable font axis settings per stack.
